purpose: Compare the existing Blender operator join with the NumPy/foreach bulk merge before another full stadium export.

fixture.geometry: Repeated 16-segment cylinder wall meshes with varied object translation, rotation, and scale; this is not the production city geometry.

outputValidation: Both paths produced 32 merged meshes with matching total vertex and polygon counts.
limits: The repeated fixture has simpler surfaces and shared source mesh datablocks than the 13,338-object production world.
The first full-world Python-list merge attempt was slower than the previous operator on its first material group and was interrupted before save/export.
Full production timing showed no bulk speedup; only the separate small fixture checks exact geometry equivalence between merge output and source surfaces.

productionFollowup.conclusion: Synthetic bulk speedup did not transfer to production geometry. Default threshold is above all current groups; keep bulk as a tested alternative only.
